aspect: Irreversible choices made on no information
description: Leaving the house may be what saves the family or what kills it, and the difference is not knowable in advance. The choice still has to be made by a specific person at a specific hour.
energy_note: Responsibility without the means to be right.

aspect: Every outcome becomes retrospective evidence of your judgement
description: Whatever happens, the survivor treats it as proof of a decision they made. A neighbour's house hit becomes 'we were right'; their own becomes 'I should have known'. Neither inference is valid and both are made.
energy_note: Convicted by an outcome you did not control.

aspect: Decision fatigue in the technical sense
description: The capacity to make considered choices is finite and depletes. After a week of it, people make objectively worse decisions about objectively larger things, which is when the serious mistakes happen.
energy_note: Worst judgement exactly when it matters most.

aspect: SECONDARY - the habit of not deciding
description: Years later, ordinary choices - a job, a flat, a relationship - get deferred indefinitely, because the nervous system has learned that committing to a course of action is how people get hurt.
energy_note: A life put permanently on 'wait and see'.
